apps.name: Debrify
apps.subtitle: Your personal media hub
apps.localizedDescription: Debrify is an open-source, cross-platform media hub. Browse, stream, and organize media from Plex, debrid services, WebDAV, IPTV, and Stremio addons — with a built-in cinematic player.
apps.versionDescription: feature/plex-integration build (+57). Plex integration, IPTV, localization, and player fixes.
